literal: Let her sulk indeed, she of bright ornaments, while I entreat; let it lengthen indeed, the night.
translation: Let my beloved of bright ornaments prolong her feigned anger so that I may go on entreating her; and let the night also lengthen so that this sweet state may endure.
modern: ஒளிரும் ஆபரணங்களை அணிந்த என் காதலி ஊடல் கொள்ளட்டும், அவளை நான் கெஞ்சி இரந்து சமாதானம் செய்யட்டும்; அதற்கு ஏதுவாக இந்த இரவும் நீளட்டும்.
explanation: The speaker finds immense pleasure in the act of appeasing his beloved when she is feigning anger. He wishes for her to continue her sulking so that he can enjoy the sweet pleasure of begging for her grace. To allow this intimate play of love to continue without interruption, he also wishes for the night to stretch out and become longer. The particle 'manno' expresses a strong desire or wish, highlighting the intensity of his love.
